title: Forge coverage mapping file
description: docs/coverage/<area>.json: an array of entries, each mapping one CyberChef operation name (from docs/coverage/cyberchef.json) to the Forge words that cover it, or recording that it was redesigned or dropped. 'forge' items are either a catalogue word, written vocab:word, using the canonical name or an alias of that vocabulary (base64:decode, classical:rot13), or a structural recipe step written step:<kind>, where <kind> is one of fork, subsection, if, repeat or comment (RECIPES section 3.2). Structural steps are not catalogue ops, so a CyberChef operation that Forge replaced with one is 'redesigned' and names the step here. Names that are not mapped anywhere are shown as 'not yet' in docs/COVERAGE.md; do not list future work.

cyberchef.description: The exact CyberChef operation name, as in docs/coverage/cyberchef.json.

forge.description: The Forge words that cover the operation. Required and non-empty for covered and redesigned; absent or empty for dropped.

note.description: Why: required for redesigned and dropped, optional for covered.
